25.09.2025 WPMB No. 800 of 2025
Hon’ble G. Narendar, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi and Ms. Neeti Rana, 
learned counsel for respondent nos. 1 to 3. 
3. Counsel for respondent nos. 1 to 3 was directed 
to produce the experience certificate, enclosed by 
respondent no. 4 with the bid document. Counsel for 
respondent nos. 1 to 3 has placed on record the 
experience certificate issued on 05.04.2025 issued by 
Satish Chand Nautiyal, Executive Engineer. There 
appears to be a discrepancy in the said certificate, as it 
refers to Contract No. 05/2015-16 of operation and 
maintenance of 20 MLD STP, whereas in the certificate 
issued, it refers to the upkeep and maintenance of the 
said STP. 
4. Counsel for respondent nos. 1 to 3 is directed to 
supply a copy of Contract No. 05/2015-16. 
5. Mr. Satish Chand Nautiyal, Executive Engineer 
shall remain present before the Court on the next date 
of listing. 
6. List this case on 10.10.2025.
7. Till the next date of listing, all further 
proceedings in pursuance to the Tender Notice dated 
11.03.2025 shall remain stayed.
8. The original record produced by the respondent  nos. 1 to 3 shall be kept before the Registrar (Judicial).
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (G. Narendar, C.J.) 
 25.09.2025 25.09.2025
Rahul
